title: Grilled Peruvian Chicken Skewers with Redcurrant Glaze
description: A flavorful and healthy dish featuring marinated chicken skewers grilled to perfection and served with a sweet and tangy redcurrant glaze.
instructions: 2. Cut chicken breast into 1-inch pieces and thread onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together Peruvian vivid vinegar, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
4. Brush the marinade onto the chicken skewers, making sure they're fully coated.
5. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
6. Meanwhile, combine redcurrant and red onion in a blender or food processor.
7. Blend until smooth, then transfer to a saucepan and simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes.
8. Brush the redcurrant glaze onto the grilled skewers during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
